# Baseline harness output. Regenerated by:
#   node tools/dyn.mjs > reference/baseline-dyn.txt
# Numbers here are the state at the bug-audit pass. A diff is the signal.
#
# Changed from the previous baseline, deliberately: the recorder scenario now
# nibbles at the extraction and requires it to fail (it used to succeed), and
# the colony scenario now moves the swimmer 300 m and requires the animal to
# still be reachable. Both new lines exist because the old assertions could
# not fail. No simulated quantity moved.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
DERIVED CONSTANTS  (every number quoted in a comment, checkable)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  shell ring frequency       358.4 Hz    c_L/(2 pi R), R = 2.35 m
  ovalling mode n=2           11.3 Hz    infrasonic: felt, not heard
  hull modes the creak may use:
      groan   215.8 Hz   Q  34   decay    0.62 s
      groan   358.4 Hz   Q  28   decay    0.90 s
      snap    539.5 Hz   Q  40   decay    0.38 s
      snap    863.2 Hz   Q  46   decay    0.24 s
  cabin air modes:
      axial          9.5 Hz   <- below hearing. The length of the boat is silent.
      transverse    36.5 Hz
      vertical      50.4 Hz
  blade pass, idle 380 rpm    31.7 Hz    carried by its harmonics, not its fundamental
  blade pass, full 1450 rpm  120.8 Hz
  mains hum, fixed           100.0 Hz    does not move with the telegraph
  bubble, 2 mm at surface    1621 Hz
  bubble, 2 mm at 426 m     10675 Hz    sqrt(P): the blow tells you your depth
  Thorp at 1 kHz            0.0690 dB/km  -> 0.00138 dB over 20 m
                                       water does not muffle anything at this range

  helm station local yaw 180 deg, looking along hull +Z
  D  starboard   bow swings RIGHT (want RIGHT)  dot   0.986   heading 0 -> 80 (+80)   ok

  helm agrees with the view, and the compass counts up to starboard

LIFE SUPPORT  —  how long is an excursion, and what ends it
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  canister capacity 15.0 l CO2 usable  (0.25 kg sorbent x 120 l/kg, halved for 4 C water)

  duration by how hard you swim:
    floating still    58.8 min   0.26 l/min CO2
    gentle 1.5 m/s    31.8 min   0.47 l/min CO2
    cruise 4.4 m/s    16.8 min   0.89 l/min CO2
    boosted 11.4 m/s  9.3 min   1.61 l/min CO2

  the last quarter of a canister, at a cruise:
    warn       at 12.60 min   left 25%  breath 28 bpm  veil 0.00  alarm 0.13
    critical   at 15.46 min   left 8%  breath 37 bpm  veil 0.00  alarm 1.00
    blackout   at 16.81 min   left 0%  breath 43 bpm  veil 0.85  alarm 1.00
    wake       at 16.87 min   left 100%  breath 34 bpm  veil 1.00  alarm 1.00
    came round after 3.0 s of fade, phase ok, canister fresh

  came back at 12% after 14.8 min out; full again 19.4 s later, phase ok
  the loop closes both ways: blackout, and a swap you have to wait for
